points.label: Versus the backtest
points.text: The swing shares are +₹8.9k combined with 20 of 36 in profit and no drawdown, so there is nothing to compare yet: 5 weeks and 2 closed trades against −21.3% max drawdown and PF 1.75 tested. points.label: Decision
points.text: Stop opening new option trades until the protection and clean-up gap is closed. New spreads add margin and tail risk while today's open problems are still unresolved. Resume once every short has a GTT and the 4 stopped-out spreads are closed.

action: Today: delete the 2 stale GTTs, close the 4 stopped-out spreads and CONCOR, place GTTs on the 17 unprotected shorts, and open no new option trades until that is done.
